words.sanskrit: chakshuh-drishti-nirodhe abhraih suryah na asti iti manyate

meaning.en: when clouds block sight, one thinks the sun does not exist
meaning.hi: बादलों से दृष्टि रुकने पर सूर्य के न होने की मान्यता बनती है

words.sanskrit: tatha ajnana-avritah dehi brahma na asti iti manyate

meaning.en: so the ignorance-covered soul thinks Brahman does not exist
meaning.hi: वैसे ही अज्ञान-आवृत जीव ब्रह्म के न होने की मान्यता बनाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatha amritam visha-adbhinnam visha-doshaih na lipyate

meaning.en: as nectar, distinct from poison, is untouched by poison's faults
meaning.hi: जैसे विष से भिन्न अमृत विष के दोषों से अलिप्त रहता है

meaning.en: I, distinct from inert matter, am untouched by its faults, shining in my own light
meaning.hi: जड़ से भिन्न मैं, अपने प्रकाश से जड़ के दोषों से अछूता हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: svalpa api dipa-kanika bahulam nashayet tamah

meaning.en: even a small spark of a lamp destroys great darkness
meaning.hi: दीपक की एक छोटी चिंगारी भी बड़े अंधकार को नष्ट कर देती है

words.sanskrit: svalpah api bodhah nibide bahulam nashayet tamah

meaning.en: even a little understanding destroys dense ignorance
meaning.hi: थोड़ी सी समझ भी घने अज्ञान को नष्ट कर देती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: kala-traye yatha sarpah rajjau na asti

meaning.en: as a snake does not exist in a rope across all three times
meaning.hi: जैसे तीनों कालों में रस्सी में साँप नहीं होता

words.sanskrit: tatha mayi ahankara-adi-deha-antam jagat na asti aham advayah

meaning.en: so in me, the world made of ego ending in the body does not exist; I am without a second
meaning.hi: वैसे ही मुझमें अहंकार-शरीर तक का संसार नहीं; मैं अद्वैत हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: being of the nature of consciousness, I have no dullness
meaning.hi: चिद्रूप होने से मुझमें जड़ता नहीं

meaning.en: being of the nature of truth, I have no falsehood
meaning.hi: सत्यरूप होने से मुझमें असत्य नहीं

meaning.en: being of the nature of bliss, I have no sorrow
meaning.hi: आनंदरूप होने से मुझमें दुख नहीं

meaning.en: these appear only from ignorance, as if true
meaning.hi: यह अज्ञान से ही सत्य-सा प्रतीत होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: having contemplated this Upanishad of self-awareness for even a moment
meaning.hi: आत्मबोध उपनिषद् पर एक क्षण भी ध्यान करके

words.sanskrit: na sah punah avartate na sah punah avartate iti upanishat

meaning.en: one does not return again, does not return again — this is the teaching
meaning.hi: वह फिर नहीं लौटता, फिर नहीं लौटता — यही उपनिषद् है
